mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, we are seeing fair conditions near the Military Ridge State Trail with a temperature of 70 degrees. Tonight, the International Space Station will make a clear pass across the sky starting at 5:43 PM, traveling from over Mount Horeb toward the East Northeast in the direction of Fitchburg and Madison.

City Hall has posted election notices regarding the November 2026 general election. Additionally, the Plan Commission is reviewing new development projects at Liberty Business Park, including a site plan for Sub-Zero.

There is plenty to do in our community. Enjoy live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard, followed by live music at the Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow and the Dane County Farmers Market on the Square tomorrow.

The Verona Police Department reported that on October 25, a 40-year-old man was taken into custody and arrested for an O W I after officers located him in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Culver's is serving up Raspberry Cheesecake as the flavor of the day. The restaurant is currently open, so feel free to stop by before they close at 10:30 PM tonight.
